fusions.name: Snared in the Shrouds
fusions.desc: A lashing strike that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Stunned] for 1 second, then slows it by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Plaited Line
fusions.desc: Casts a plaited line into the first enemy it meets; it deals 7 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Strung Rigging
fusions.desc: Strings a wall of cordage 6 tiles long in front of you for 6 seconds, blocking enemies from passing.

fusions.name: Woven Hawser
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once on a shield worth 7% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
